summary: This is a documentation page that displays all article series on a blog. It imports styling and React components, then uses those components to show statistics about the series, translation coverage information, and a grid of cards representing each series collection.

explanations.3: This tells the documentation generator not to display the automatic table of contents that would normally appear on this page.
explanations.5: This metadata field specifies who wrote or maintains this page — in this case, someone with the username 'christophe'.
explanations.8: This loads custom CSS styling rules specifically for formatting the series display on this page.
explanations.10: This comment tells the markdown linter to ignore a specific formatting rule (MD041) for this file, usually because the page structure doesn't follow typical markdown conventions.
explanations.28: The {" "} is a way to insert a literal space in JSX; without it, whitespace between JSX elements gets collapsed.
explanations.31: This creates a styled container div with the class name 'seriesIntro' that holds the introductory text below it.
